# Protocol Contract Checklist: Allocation Period and Partial-Selection Scope

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the allocation window, its echo, and the selector are complete,
unambiguous, and compatible, before and during PR review
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]`
only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does
not mean implementation work is complete.

## Window Rules

- [ ] CHK001 Are the window rules stated to be identical to the usage request's rules, including the
  start-equals-end case? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it stated that the window never changes an allocated cost, including for run-rate usage?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]

## Echo Rule and Compatibility

- [ ] CHK003 Are all three echo outcomes defined: absent (accepted), matching (accepted), and differing or
  unrequested (rejected)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the split between what hosts accept at runtime and what conformance requires stated and justified?
  [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "equal" defined precisely enough for timestamps (the full value, not a rounded one)? [Ambiguity,
  Spec §FR-008]

## Selector Semantics

- [ ] CHK006 Is the selector's meaning tied to the usage request's selector, including the reserved namespace key?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it explicit that no invariant is relaxed under a selector? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary between allocator duty (SHOULD warn) and host duty (SHOULD omit or label) stated
  without overlap? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated that the warning's text is not part of the contract? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Conformance and SDK Parity

- [ ] CHK010 Are the conformance scenarios named with their pass and fail conditions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 Is TypeScript coverage defined for sending the new fields and reading the echo? [Completeness, Spec
  §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the documentation targets listed, including the host rule for partial selections? [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and
  `/speckit-clarify`
